dubious/odd statement on Qadiri arrival ('according to the stated chronological account'; most books say 15th c.)

pyq_bad.why: garbled: stray option text from another question in stem

patterns: APPSC asks single facts: Gesudaraz = Chishti (vs Zakariya, Naqshband, Waliullah), Urs of Moinuddin at Ajmer, Gesudaraz = Gulbarga.
Other PSCs hammer titles (Mehboob-i-Ilahi, Chiragh-i-Delhi, Shaikh-ul-Hind), dargah locations, Baba Farid in Adi Granth, Naqshbandi against music.
Classic trap: Chishti named after a village near Herat, not Ajmer (A true, R false).
App adds deep doctrinal items (maqamat, Amritakund, Hamiduddins, Wahdat doctrines) beyond PYQ depth but mostly sound; AP angle (Tana Shah, Kadapa Ameen Peer) not yet seen in PYQs.
